title: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University Shaheed Benazirabad Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University Shaheed Benazirabad Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2011
ACT VIII OF 2011
SHAHEED BENAZIR
BHUTTO UNIVERSITY, SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Shaheed
Benazir Bhutto
University, Shaheed Banazirabad Act, 2009
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
1st March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-05/2011, dated 24-2-2011.---The Shaheed
Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed
Benazirabad (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 21st January,
2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 17th
February, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
amend the Shaheed
Benazir Bhutto University,
Shaheed Benazirabad Act,
2009, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University,
Shaheed Benazirabad
(Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
